name: Your Place In The World
summary: In the Valley of Trials, untested recruits take their first steps toward honor and survival in Durotar. Kaltunk sends them straight to Gornek for basic combat training, beginning their service to the Horde.

sections.title: Coming of Age in Durotar
sections.body: In Durotar's arid Valley of Trials, young orcs and Darkspear trolls prove their worth before entering the wider world. Under Warchief Thrall, life demands strength, vigilance, and discipline. Kaltunk evaluates every eager recruit, tempering dreams of wrestling demons and dragons with the practical duties ahead. Training begins in the canyon, where recruits learn humility before claiming glory.

sections.title: Reporting to Gornek
sections.body: Gornek waits beside the camp fire, only steps away from Kaltunk. The gruff veteran regards fresh arrivals with a skeptical eye and often grumbles about the meager stock reaching camp. His duty is to harden these young fighters through trials, starting with the vermin that threaten the encampment's supplies.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
aliases: what is your place in the world
faq.answer: This rite marks a young recruit's entry into Horde service in the Valley of Trials. You go straight to Gornek, who begins your basic combat training and assigns your first duties.
Kaltunk is an orc overseer at the entrance to the Valley of Trials. He evaluates coming-of-age recruits and directs them to the proper trainers and leaders in camp.
Gornek is an experienced Horde trainer seated near the campfire in the Valley of Trials. He tests incoming recruits and hardens them into capable soldiers before they leave the canyon.

faq.q: Where does this quest lead next?
aliases: next after your place in the world
faq.answer: Reporting to Gornek leads immediately to the trial 'Cutting Teeth'. Recruits head into the dirt to cull mottled boars and prove their basic martial skill.

faq.q: Why are recruits kept in the Valley of Trials?
faq.answer: The Valley of Trials is a secluded, protected canyon in Durotar where recruits are trained, evaluated, and weeded out before facing the territory's deadlier beasts, quilboar, and enemy scouts.

faq.q: Does this quest differ between orcs and trolls?
faq.answer: Young orcs and Darkspear trolls begin training together in the Valley of Trials and receive the same call to arms from Kaltunk.

angles.text: Every young Horde recruit in Durotar must prove they have the grit to defend their fledgling nation before taking up arms in the Warchief's name.
For orcs, coming of age and reporting for duty in the Valley of Trials is a cultural milestone centered on personal honor and martial readiness.
The Darkspear trolls settled in Durotar alongside their orc allies. Here, they train with their brethren to forge unity and mutual survival.
